children: NEW YORK, Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The McBride Rewind, the celebrity interview podcast hosted by television personality Josh McBride, has signed with WME for representation in all areas and entered into an exclusive partnership with Acast, expanding the show's reach as it continues to gain momentum in the entertainment podcast space.
Since its debut earlier this year,

has become known for candid conversations with actors, musicians and television personalities whose work helped define late-'90s and early-2000s pop culture. Recent guests include Whoopi Goldberg, Ja Rule, Jodie Sweetin, Christine Taylor, Andrew Keegan, Mýa and Nina Sky. Several episodes have generated follow-on coverage in outlets including
, with conversations extending beyond nostalgia into topics such as residuals, career reinvention, and the changing realities of working in Hollywood.

Acast will provide global distribution, advertising sales, and monetization support, while WME will represent the podcast as it expands across digital media, branded content, live opportunities and additional entertainment ventures. "I've always believed the best interviews happen when people forget they're being interviewed," said McBride. "Those are the moments listeners connect with most. Every guest has a story that goes beyond the role or the hit song people remember, and that's what we've built the show around. Having Acast and WME behind us allows us to keep growing while staying true to that approach."

"Josh has created a format that feels both familiar and fresh," said Jaclyn Wertheimer, Senior Development Manager at Acast. "His guests are comfortable opening up, and those conversations often become part of larger entertainment news cycles. We're looking forward to bringing the show to an even wider audience and introducing new advertising partners to such an engaged fan base."
Rather than simply revisiting memorable moments from pop culture,

focuses on the careers behind them. Guests reflect on the successes, challenges and turning points that shaped their lives, offering listeners a perspective that's both nostalgic and relevant to today's entertainment landscape.
With support from WME and Acast, the podcast will continue to expand its guest lineup while exploring new opportunities across audio, video and live programming.
is available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube and wherever podcasts are distributed.
Josh McBride is a television host, producer and entertainment journalist with nearly 15 years of on-air experience. He has appeared on programs including
and numerous national and syndicated broadcasts. He is recognized for his conversational interview style and longstanding relationships throughout the entertainment industry.

is a weekly interview podcast featuring conversations with actors, musicians and entertainers whose work helped shape late-'90s and early-2000s pop culture. Each episode looks beyond the headlines, exploring the careers, creative journeys and personal stories behind some of entertainment's most recognizable names.

Acast is the global authority on podcasting, building the infrastructure that serves as the single point of entry for the whole industry. This enables creators to grow and monetize across audio, video, social, and beyond, and brands to buy at scale - without walls or borders. As the world's largest pure-play podcast company, we connect 140,000+ storytellers with 4,000+ advertisers globally. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ACAST).
